name: sentry-mcp
description: Triage Sentry issues, read events and stack traces, and manage assignments — for self-hosted Sentry.
long_description:
Exposes a self-hosted Sentry instance as MCP tools: search and read issues, pull events and stack traces, check for missing debug symbols, resolve/ignore/assign, and comment. Responses default to compact TOON to save tokens.

Fill in your Sentry URL, auth token and organisation slug below, or leave them blank to reuse an existing ~/.sentry-mcp.json. The token needs at least org:read, project:read and event:read — add project:write and event:admin for the mutation tools.

sentry_token.title: Sentry auth token
sentry_token.description: Settings → Account → API → Auth Tokens. Scopes: org:read, project:read, event:read (+ project:write, event:admin to mutate).

sentry_org.title: Organisation slug
sentry_org.description: The org part of your Sentry URLs, e.g. "acme" in /organizations/acme/issues/.
